title: Tree-Guided Identify-Then-Exploit: A Unified Framework of Best Arm Identification and Regret Minimization for Dueling Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2606.01799v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study $N$-armed stochastic dueling bandits under the Condorcet-winner assumption with a positive global gap, where three widely adopted objectives are considered: best-arm identification (BAI), weak regret, and strong regret. We propose Tree-Guided Identify-Then-Exploit (TG-ITE), the first unified framework to tackle all these objectives to our knowledge. Without requiring transitivity assumptions, we propose a shared tree-guided identification approach to find a high-confidence incumbent within $O(N)$ comparisons. We further propose varied exploitation strategies to utilize this warm-start stage to optimize the specific objectives at hand. For a fixed global gap $\Delta$, this methodology enables our approach to (1) build the first winner-stays-style algorithm to achieve $O(N)$ weak regret; (2) realize the joint optimization of BAI and weak regret with $O(N)$ guarantees for both, eliminating the sub-optimal $O(\log N)$ factors of

translated_title: 树引导的先识别后利用：对决老虎机中最优臂识别与遗憾最小化的统一框架
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在孔多塞赢家假设且全局间隙为正的条件下，$N$ 臂随机对决老虎机问题，考虑了三种广泛采用的目标：最优臂识别（BAI）、弱遗憾和强遗憾。我们提出了树引导的先识别后利用框架（TG-ITE），据我们所知，这是首个能够统一处理所有这些目标的框架。在无需传递性假设的情况下，我们提出了一种共享的树引导识别方法，能够在 $O(N)$ 次比较内找到高置信度的当前最优臂。我们进一步提出了多种利用策略，利用这一热启动阶段来优化当前的具体目标。对于固定的全局间隙 $\Delta$，该方法使我们的方案能够：（1）构建首个赢家停留式算法以实现 $O(N)$ 的弱遗憾；（2）实现最优臂识别与弱遗憾的联合优化，两者均具有 $O(N)$ 的保证，消除了次优的 $O(\log N)$ 因子……
tldr: 提出首个统一框架TG-ITE，通过树引导识别方法在无需传递性假设下以O(N)次比较找到高置信度候选臂，并针对最优臂识别、弱遗憾和强遗憾三种目标设计相应利用策略，首次以赢家停留式算法实现O(N)弱遗憾及BAI与弱遗憾的联合优化。
en_tdlr: Proposes TG-ITE, the first unified framework for dueling bandits that uses a tree-guided identification approach to find a high-confidence incumbent in O(N) comparisons without transitivity assumptions, and applies tailored exploitation strategies to achieve O(N) weak regret via the first winner-stays-style algorithm and joint optimization of BAI and weak regret.
